data.raw_text:
Holy fu*k*n shit!!😱😱 Is this real??? Is this true?? Seriously??? 

So Malacañang, through Ante Kler, is saying that President Marcos Jr. supports Jay Tarriela after China lodged a formal protest over his statements and posts?

Support what, exactly? The JT’s lying?? Posturing? The denial?? The public maligning of Xi Jinping in front of university students? The semantic gymnastics after the video evidence contradicted him??? 

Hoy!!!!!! Ante Kler, sigurado ka ba diyan? Are you sure???? Oi, siguraduhin mo tama ka sa pag-intindi mo sa sinasabi ng boss mo…. 

Is that a clear instruction from your boss, or your own undiplomatic freestyle delivered with the confidence of someone who forgot how foreign policy and diplomacy work? Because if that line truly came from BBM, then congratulations: Malacañang has just nationalized a coastguard’s missteps and rebranded them as state policy. Bravo!!!! 👏👏👏 ...Nakakaloka itong BBM government if in any case! 

Let’s spell out the possible implications if, in any case, Ante Kler’s statements in this regard are true….

1) When a presidency publicly backs a uniformed subordinate, a coastguard, after a formal diplomatic protest, it tells Beijing and all countries across the world and all nationalities, THIS IS NOT AN INDIVIDUAL ERROR! THIS IS OUR POSITION! My goodness!!! That escalates things. Countries read signals, NOT excuses. 
Duh! 🙄🙄🙄

2) If Ante Kler’s statement is true and interpreted rightly, Marcos Jr.’s foreign policy is now PERFORMATIVE BRAVADO! It says: we’re fine with blurring the line between professional communication and public ridicule; we’re fine with meme wars! WTF!!!

3) ASEAN 2026-Chairing with a Megaphone: Now, let’s talk about timing. The Philippines is the ASEAN Chair in 2026. Chairs are expected to be honest brokers, not headline-chasers. If Malacañang is seen as endorsing undisciplined messaging that embarrasses diplomacy and the country’s foreign policy, how do you convene consensus among ten states (ASEAN has now 11 member-states), some of which are also South China Sea claimants, without looking unserious or ridiculous, or farcical? Aber!!!??? 

ASEAN leadership requires trustworthiness, restraint, and credibility. Supporting a coastguard’s political undiscipline, messaging, and political theatrics undermines all of them. 
Duh! 🙄🙄🙄
 
4) If in any case, how will the Region, PH Partners, Will Read This? Other countries won’t analyze or parse press releases the way domestic audiences do. They’ll read one thing: the Philippines backs confrontational messaging and maligning a foreign head of state in front of university students, even when it complicates diplomacy and foreign policy. That makes partner countries cautious, foreign investors nervous, and the international community skeptical. Gets??

5) Let’s look at glaring realities. China is a major trading partner. Filipinos work in Hong Kong, Macau, and mainland China. Signaling escalation doesn’t hurt “polpol” politicians at the very, very instance; it will not hurt Marcos Jr and his family first, IT WILL HURT workers, exporters, the business community, students, OFWS, and supply chains, etc, basically the Filipino people! This is the TRUTH!  

Is BBM, Malacañang, ready to sacrifice the country’s and Filipinos’ welfare and well-being, and let all of us pay the bill in support of a liar coastguard? Does it have a plan to offset the damage to the country in any case??? 

6) Support Is a Choice, and So Are Consequences: If Marcos Jr. truly supports Tarriela’s approach, then he owns the consequences: the protests, the frayed channels, the awkward summits, the ASEAN whispers, the investor questions. 

If he doesn’t, then Malacañang should STOP freelancing and REASSERT DISCIPLINE NOW! But is Marcos Jr. capable of this? Really! I am asking! Is he capable???!!!
 
Because right now, one thing is clear. Marcos Jr.’s government’s communication and messaging are in chaos!

Also, if indeed, in any case, Marcos Jr. supports Tarriela and his actions, the lying, etc., then Malacañang just admitted openly in view of the entire Philippine Republic that his foreign policy and he himself as sole author of the country’s foreign policy have been hijacked by the likes of Tarriela and this coastguard’s handlers and he is allowing it freely. If this is the case, I say, WTF!! This country is doomed under this presidency! Is it not, folks??? 

You know what, folks, backing a coastguard who caught up lying and maligning a head of state isn’t about “standing up for the country. Way far from that! It’s ELEVATING A MISTAKE INTO A STRATEGIC POSTURE! If this is indeed Malacañang’s line, then the Philippines has chosen spectacle over statecraft, right before chairing ASEAN.

Ante Kler, one last time: sigurado ka ba diyan sa mga pinagsasabi mo? Are you sure??? 

Because once the world hears “the President supports it,” there’s no un-hearing it!!
